plugin.template.name: Template
plugin.template.description: Plugin template with every layer: commands, events, services (storage, messages, tasks, API, voice), nodes and a dashboard page.
plugin.template.node.hello.label: Say hello
plugin.template.node.hello.description: Builds a greeting for a name.
plugin.template.setting.replies_hint: The node "Find reply" answers with the first entry whose trigger is in the text.
plugin.template.node.reply_for.label: Find reply
plugin.template.node.reply_for.descripti: Looks up the automatic reply for a text (settings page).
plugin.template.node.count.label: Count
plugin.template.node.count.description: Adds a step to a counter of this server and of the member.
plugin.template.node.announce.label: Announce
plugin.template.node.announce.descriptio: Sends an embed to a channel.
plugin.template.setting.welcome_text_hin: {user} mentions the new member, {server} is the server name, {count} the member count.
plugin.template.setting.report_channel_h: A short report is posted here every day at 09:00 UTC. Empty: no report.
plugin.template.node.api_get.label: Call API
plugin.template.node.api_get.description: Fetches data from the API endpoint EXAMPLE_API (set up by the admin).
plugin.template.setting.voice_channel_hi: Used when the member who triggers the node is not in a voice channel and the node names none.
plugin.template.setting.stay_connected: Stay in the channel after "Stop sound"
plugin.template.node.play_sound.label: Play sound
plugin.template.node.play_sound.descript: Joins a voice channel and plays a sound of the plugin.
plugin.template.node.stop_sound.label: Stop sound
plugin.template.node.stop_sound.descript: Stops the sound and leaves the voice channel.
